# HEngine 1.1.0

Binary engine SDK. Gameplay requires no engine C++ source download.

- AGENTS.md: installation instructions and supported tooling.
- Docs/AI_GAME_DEVELOPMENT.md: start here; create, inspect, script, validate, export.
- Docs/ScriptingGuide.md: lifecycle, resources, handles, errors, examples.
- Docs/ScriptingApiAudit-1.1.0.md: system coverage and explicit limitations.
- Docs/Api/index.md: generated, browsable C# API reference.
- Docs/Api/api-index.json: searchable API member IDs, signatures, summaries and input hashes.
- Scripting/CSharp/HEngine.ScriptCore.xml: compiled assembly documentation.
- Examples/ScriptingBasics: minimal scripts illustrating the documented API.
- Tools/Build/Capabilities.json: supported export hosts; symbols alone do not imply platform support.
- Docs/BuildAndPublish.md: project export.
